description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed ancillary use of part of the dwellinghouse as a single desk minicab booking office (no public access, no customer visits, and no material change of use)
decision_conditions: The proposals based upon the information provided in support of the application do not constitute development in accordance with section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, therefore planning permission is not required as no change of use has occurred.

However, it is worth noting that should the circumstances relating to the business alter in any respect this may change the requirements for planning permission and you should contact the Council for confirmation of these matters. The onus remains on the applicant to ensure that the development is lawful and that the use of the property remains as a single dwelling house.
